meta.title: 拍照干货❗️上镜怎么找角度！？
meta.title_en: Photo Tips — How to Find Your On-Camera Angle

scenes.title_cn: 死亡角度：人类拍照的死亡角度——不要…
sentences: 人类拍照的死亡角度：抬高、低头、翻白眼、抬头纹。
Photography's dead angles: chin up, chin down, eye-roll, brow lines.
dead angles（死亡角度）
抬脸时只需要把下巴抬高20度，微抬一点点就可以了。
When lifting, raise the chin just 20 degrees—a tiny lift.
20-degree lift（微抬20度）
抬得过高面部不立体，皮肤显得很大，脸显得很平。
Lift too much and the face loses dimension and goes flat.
too high is flat（过高显平）
scenes.speak: Photography's dead angles: chin up, chin down, eye-roll, brow lines. When lifting, raise the chin just 20 degrees—a tiny lift. Lift too much and the face loses dimension and goes flat.

scenes.title_cn: 低头与侧脸：低头的时候也是微低20度…
scenes.title_en: Down and side: tilt down just 20 degrees t…
sentences: 低头也是微低20度，侧面也是微侧，尽量保持在45度以内。
Tilt down 20 degrees; the side is a micro-turn within 45 degrees.
within 45 degrees（45度内）
眼睛看着镜头，脸侧太多会很很难受。
Facing the lens while the face turns far is uncomfortable.
uncomfortable（难受）
45度、30度或15度角，脸微微移中微微抬，面部更好看。
At 45, 30, or 15 degrees with a slight shift and lift, the face looks better.
find your angle（找到角度）
scenes.speak: Tilt down 20 degrees; the side is a micro-turn within 45 degrees. Facing the lens while the face turns far is uncomfortable. At 45, 30, or 15 degrees with a slight shift and lift, the face looks better.

scenes.title_cn: 侧脸眼神：转向侧面的时候要注意一个点…
scenes.title_en: Profile gaze: when you turn to the side, n…
scenes.context: 眼随脸向平视，不要反向。
sentences: 眼睛千万不要跟相机在反方向去看，眼白会过多。
Never look opposite the camera—too much sclera.
too much sclera（眼白过多）
眼睛跟脸转向的角度平视过去，可以微抬平视或微低。
Gaze level with the face's angle—up, level, or down.
level gaze（平视）
都是微微地周转，而不是大幅度地周转。
Everything is a slight adjustment, never a large swing.
slight adjustments（微微周转）
scenes.speak: Never look opposite the camera—too much sclera. Gaze level with the face's angle—up, level, or down. Everything is a slight adjustment, never a large swing.

practice: Chin up too high, chin down, eye-roll, brow lines.
Lift the chin just 20 degrees for an even face.
Keep the side turn within 45 degrees.
Gaze level with the face's turning angle.
pitfalls: A tiny 20-degree lift keeps the face even.
Turn the face far from the lens.
Keep the side turn within 45 degrees.
侧脸夹角要控制在45度内。
Look opposite the camera in profile.
Gaze level with the face's angle.
shifts: 用 dead angles（死亡角度）、20-degree lift（微抬20度）、within 45 degrees（45度内）
用 even face（面部平整）、double chin（双下巴）、forehead lines（抬头纹）
用 level gaze（平视）、too much sclera（眼白过多）、slight adjustment（微微周转）
